name: Build My Journey
summary: A private planning service — not a fixed 15-day package. Share your dates, regions, pace, and goals; our Kabul team designs a quotation around current access. Duration and price are set only after we scope the journey with you.
description: Build My Journey is an inquiry-led leisure planning service. Share timing, regions, pace, group size, and goals. Duration, routing, and pricing are outputs of planning — not catalog fields. Distinct from specialist services and return journeys.
audience: Travelers seeking a private bespoke leisure journey
